title: The Hawk and Azure Strength Canon
summary: A canon of falling weight and winged guards that ends in the stoop of a giant on a target beneath it.

title: Treatise of the Twin-Court Fist
summary: A treatise on two fists as a court of two that pass a verdict in paired blows and close on the gavel stroke.

title: The River Strength Mastery
summary: A mastery of strength that flows like a river around a guard and floods it in the end with a vast weight.

title: Compendium of the Dual-Track Body
summary: A compendium on running the body and the qi along two tracks at once so that force and guard come as a pair.

title: The Azure Colossus Codex
summary: A codex of the huge azure frame that looms and presses and ends in the wrath of a titan.

title: The Paired Titan Mastery
summary: A mastery of titan strokes in pairs where hammer and rebuke fall together and end in a sundering.

title: The Wind-Sworn Titan Canon
summary: A canon of the wind-sworn that binds a titan's strength to an oath and brings it down on a target at last.

title: Oath of the Unmoved Frame
summary: A sworn manual of the frame that does not move and clears the body of every taint before it breaks its foe.

title: Treatise of the Unwalled Fist
summary: A treatise on the open fist that hides behind no cover and fills the field around it with weight.

title: Manual of the Long Bearing
summary: A manual of the long bearing held through a full exchange until it ends in one unending crush.

title: The Bearing and Burden Mastery
summary: A mastery of carrying a burden along a bearing and loosing the whole weight of it as a crushing wave.

title: The Sworn Heavy Hand Canon
summary: A canon of the heavy hand sworn to an oath of ruin that ends in a single blow of the ruinhand.
